description: This file defines the AWS BedrockAgentClient class, a PHP client for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Agent service via AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to agents, knowledge bases, flows, prompts, and other resources.

classes.name: BedrockAgentClient
classes.description: A client class for Amazon Bedrock Agent service, extending AWS SDK's generic AWSClient class, providing methods to interact with the service.

methods.name: associateAgentCollaborator
methods.description: Associates a collaborator with an agent in Amazon Bedrock.

methods.name: createKnowledgeBase
methods.description: Creates a new knowledge base resource.

methods.name: getFlow
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific flow.
